masteryZone.q: Which of the following is a Lewis base?
masteryZone.sol: NH₃ (Ammonia) has a lone pair of electrons to donate, making it a Lewis base.

masteryZone.q: True or False: Turmeric turns pink in a basic solution.
masteryZone.sol: False. Turmeric turns reddish-brown in basic solutions.
Phenolphthalein is pink in basic solutions and colorless in acidic solutions.

masteryZone.q: Tooth decay starts when mouth pH is:
masteryZone.sol: Tooth decay begins below pH 5.5 as the enamel starts dissolving.

masteryZone.q: True or False: Acid rain has a pH value higher than 6.0.
masteryZone.sol: False. Acid rain is characterized by pH below 5.6.

masteryZone.q: What is the chemical formula of bleaching powder?
True or False: Washing soda contains 10 water molecules of crystallization.
masteryZone.sol: True. Washing soda formula is Na₂CO₃·10H₂O.
